Start with an e-mail, a username, a phone number or a wallet. Veiled Eye checks 46 sources, follows every lead they return, and puts the result into one profile and one relationship graph.

Selectors

One box. Any selector.

Paste what you have. Veiled Eye works out what it is and sends it only to the sources that can use it. Several selectors at once work too: they are researched together and merged.

john.doe@acme-labs.io
RunsE-mail registrations, Gravatar, breaches and infostealer logs, PGP keys, dark web and .onion indexes.
Pivoting

It follows the leads.

A GitHub profile lists an e-mail and an X handle. Veiled Eye looks up both, then checks what those point to. Every step is kept in a trail, so you can see why something is in the profile.

  • Always endsTwo levels deep with a fixed lookup budget, so a search never runs away.
  • No noiseGeneric handles such as admin, support or reel are never chased.
  • Agreement countsAn account found on one source only stays a candidate until another source agrees.
Screens

What comes back.

Search results per source, one merged profile, and a relationship graph you can filter, search and export.

127.0.0.1:4300

A username search: the GitHub profile, search engine hits, social profiles, names, usernames and hashtags found.

Inside

What it checks.

Accounts
Maigret, WhatsMyName and User-Scanner across thousands of sites, GitHub in depth, Telegram, Instagram, Reddit, Steam, Bluesky, Hacker News and indexed cybercrime forums.
E-mail
Where an address is registered, Gravatar, breaches, infostealer logs and PGP keys.
Phone
Carrier, line type and region from the number itself, whether it is registered on Instagram, Snapchat or Amazon, and where it appears on the web.
Wallets
Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Tron and Dogecoin: balance, first and last activity, top counterparties and public tags.
Cross-analysis
Confirmed, likely or candidate by how many sources agree. The same profile picture behind two accounts is matched. Reverse image search links are one click away.
Output
Relationship graph, map and timeline. Export a PDF or HTML report, STIX 2.1, GraphML, CSV or JSON.
Install

Two commands.

Needs Python 3.10 or newer. The web interface opens on your own machine; nothing is sent to a server of ours.

Download .zip Source

1 / Install

$ pip install veiled-eye

2 / Start

$ veiled-eye serve

3 / Open

http://127.0.0.1:4300

The web interface uses Redis. If redis-server is installed it is started for you. Otherwise run docker run -d -p 6379:6379 redis:7-alpine.
